01: When the last person walks away from the grave... he can still hear their footsteps.
02: Mom... what really happens when someone is buried?
03: The Prophet, peace be upon him, told us: he even hears the footsteps of the people leaving.
04: Then two angels come to him, make him sit up, and ask him about Muhammad, peace be upon him.
05: And the believer will answer: I testify that he is Allah's servant and His Messenger. Then he is shown his place in Paradise.
06: But Mom... what if I forget the answer?
07: That answer isn't learned in the grave, my dear. It's learned now. In your prayer, and in your kindness.
08: Then... I'll start learning it tonight.
